components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only high-emphasis action style. Use for provisioning, opening workflows, and committing clear operator actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #2563eb); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: var(--accent-fg, #fff); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s, border-color .12s, color .12s, transform .04s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(37,99,235,.10)); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; filter: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action style for management navigation and non-primary commands.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4d8); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: transparent; color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); font: inherit; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .12s, border-color .12s, color .12s, transform .04s; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #fafafa); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(37,99,235,.10)); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Compact semantic state marker for quote, keyset, health, and setup status.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-pill, 999px); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; background: var(--surface-2, #fafafa); color: var(--fg-muted, #71717a); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); } .ds-pill::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-pill-active { background: var(--accent-soft, rgba(37,99,235,.10)); color: var(--accent, #2563eb); border-color: transparent; }

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); border: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); border-radius: var(--radius, 10px); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 14px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e4e4e7); background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-card-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: -0.005em; } .ds-card-meta { color: var(--fg-muted, #71717a); font-size: 13px; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px 20px; color: var(--fg-muted, #71717a); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard setup and operations field with clear focus feedback.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); font: inherit; } .ds-field span { color: var(--fg-muted, #71717a); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong, #d4d4d8); border-radius: var(--radius-sm, 6px); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--fg, #0a0a0a); font: inherit; font-size: 14px; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #2563eb); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent-soft, rgba(37,99,235,.10)); } .ds-field small { color: var(--fg-subtle, #a1a1aa); font-size: 12px; }

narrative.overview: Pecan is calm, exact, operational infrastructure software. It favors dense but readable panels, explicit state, and familiar controls so branch operators and mint administrators can provision and run a custom unit mint without editing config files or knowing CDK internals.
keyCharacteristics: Dense operational layouts with clear grouping and stable dimensions.
Plain labels and state names before clever copy.
One accent used for primary actions, active state, and information emphasis.
Irreversible or security-sensitive choices are explained before action.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only non-semantic accent. Do not introduce extra brand colors for decoration.

rules.name: The No Hero Type Rule
rules.body: This is an operational tool. Do not use oversized display type inside dashboards, forms, cards, or setup panels.

rules.name: The Flat By Default Rule
rules.body: Prefer borders and tonal layers. Do not increase shadow blur to make a panel feel important.

dos: Do keep interfaces calm, exact, and operational.
Do use the existing CSS variables before introducing new visual values.
Do explain irreversible decisions before the operator commits them.
Do pair semantic color with text labels.
donts: Don't create marketing-style landing pages for app surfaces.
Don't use crypto-dashboard spectacle, neon palettes, glass panels, or decorative gradients.
Don't rely on terminal-only workflows or hidden manual configuration steps.
Don't assume the operator already knows Cashu/CDK internals.
Don't nest cards inside cards or use cards as decorative page sections.
